headline: Reserve Bank of India Injects Liquidity via ₹50,000 Crore Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India allotted ₹50,005 crore in a 4-day Variable Rate Repo auction, receiving ₹1.52 trillion in financial system bids at a cut-off yield of 5.62%.
why: Variable Rate Repo operations are key monetary tools used by the RBI to regulate short-term interbank liquidity in India.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Liquidity injection via repo auction satisfies commercial bank short-term reserve requirements.
